authority.basis: Root assignment to stage H230 seed-3 epoch-1 upload-ready ZIP using the existing independently written C1/export/native path; no public upload authorized.
authority.scope: Candidate-alone seed3 epoch1 package; package generation/validation only; no fitting, science score, control blend or public upload.

implementation_binding.source_code_and_build: Own project `scripts/package_submission.py`, existing project C1 `solution.py` wrapper and Rust native engine; no teammate weights/code/libraries are included.

mathematical_export.exactness: For each of output rows 0 and 1, y_j = dot(W_j,h)+b_j; no other output row is an input to y_j. `scripts/package_submission.py` exports contiguous `head.2.weight[:2]` and `head.2.bias[:2]`. This preserves the H230 candidate first-two outputs exactly in real arithmetic; family auxiliary outputs are omitted from inference. Structural/tensor equality and delivered-ZIP numeric parity remain mandatory checks.
mathematical_export.head_source: E529 `append_family_output_head` adds only independent rows to final nn.Linear output; primary target rows remain indices 0:2.
mathematical_export.model_source: E529 H230 source-v2 RNNModel: concatenated recurrent/projection feature -> Linear(2H,H) -> GELU -> Linear(H,n_out).

validation_plan.archive_integrity: Inspect named ZIP members and bytes, safe unique paths, zip CRC, size <=20MB, and byte-identical copy of staging submission.zip.
validation_plan.callback: Run actual ZIP through scripts/check_submission_python311.py offline CPU-only, network-none container on two complete valid_subset20 streams for v2, avx2, v3; check reset/determinism and exact output to archived native.
validation_plan.checkpoint_export: Compare exported NPZ tensors against checkpoint: every trunk tensor identical; final weight and bias equal checkpoint rows 0:2 exactly; only auxiliary output rows omitted.
validation_plan.float32_parity: Produce a candidate-only CPU-float32 reference from the frozen E529 model/checkpoint for two exact streams; compare after warm-up against delivered ZIP native-i16 output; retain the existing 0.0003 max-absolute gate.
validation_plan.independent_review: Root independently grades H230 prediction and reviews package evidence; actor does not self-approve. No public upload.
validation_plan.runtime: Run scripts/verify_submission.py on cache/valid_subset20.parquet, one CPU/one thread/1GB/600s; record 20-sequence runtime and resource peak without claiming full-scorer or public runtime.
validation_plan.static_abi: Run scripts/check_submission_abi.py on the delivered ZIP; require no libpython dependency and supported glibc ceiling as prior C1 gate.
